Module permutation proves the specific matching histogram structurally; the root-extension argument proves unlimited collisions. The limited-size classification is not extrapolated to larger sizes.

originality.rationale: The full 2012 PD rarefaction article establishes moment evaluation but does not identify shapes or a sharp obstruction. Schwob 2026 and OEIS A382440 already cover subtree-size multisets (the mean-only invariant) and hence imply known first-moment collisions, not equivalence for the pair-union invariant controlling variances. Exact comparison with those stronger related premises, published primary comparisons and further literature searches found no covering theorem for the one-pair sixteen-leaf second-moment threshold; the residual risk of overlooked equivalent combinatorial formulations is retained.
residual_risks: An equivalent sixteen-leaf two-clade-union fingerprint theorem might exist under ecological inverse problems, subtree polynomials or graph reliability language not exposed by the searches.
Known single-size classes and general PD variance formulas already substantially overlap the machinery, so only the sharp joint-moment identification and separation are claimed.
The later Schwob result concerns a different equivalence relation and is not claimed as wholly irrelevant; its subtree exchange provides a related combinatorial mechanism.

value.rationale: PD rarefaction curves are a substantive compressed observation in ecological phylogenetics; the source article explicitly motivates sensitivity to tree shape. An exact injectivity threshold for complete first-two-moment curves addresses a natural and previously unaccounted inverse question: which branching histories are distinguishable by these statistics? The first failure is unique among 10,905 sixteen-leaf shapes, third-moment information resolves it, and a constructive family exhibits unavoidable ambiguity at all higher orders. This gives a motivated sharp boundary and a path for richer measurements rather than an arbitrary small-case recomputation; the unit-edge, unknown-label, noise-free assumptions remain essential.
